name: Adi Buy Now & Quick Cart for WooCommerce
author: Adiyan Kashem

sections.description:
ADIBNQC Add to Cart and Buy Now is a lightweight, high-performance plugin designed to improve your WooCommerce store’s conversion rate. It adds modern, customizable “Buy Now” buttons that redirect users directly to checkout, along with AJAX-powered Add to Cart buttons for grid views.

Key Features:

  • Dual Button System: Add both “Add to Cart” and “Buy Now” buttons.
  • Direct Checkout: The Buy Now button sends users directly to the checkout page.
  • Zero Conflict Mode: Uses intelligent CSS isolation to ensure it works with any theme.
  • 3rd Party Compatibility: Compatible with custom field plugins (e.g., Advanced Product Fields).
  • Elementor Widgets: Includes 3 dedicated widgets for full design control.
  • AJAX Support: Works seamlessly with or without AJAX enabled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/adi-buy-now-quick-cart directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings menu to configure button colors and labels.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Initial release for WordPress.org.
  • Added security nonces for AJAX.
  • Implemented CSS isolation mode.
